packageRules.description: Bump the mise.toml and packageManager pnpm pins in one PR so they cannot drift
CI never starts Foundry, so a new build can change behaviour the module depends on while every check stays green
prBodyNotes:
**Before merging this Foundry build:**

- [ ] Walk the scenarios in `packages/foundry-module/test/manual/` against it
- [ ] Check that `compatibility.verified` in `packages/foundry-module/module.json` matches it
- [ ] Check that `@league-of-foundry-developers/foundry-vtt-types` tracks it
